Homepage hero, round 5: three new designs (A, B, C) at Mobile 390 / Tablet 768 / Desktop 1440.
Same live copy word for word, same Midland, Texas photo, same palette. Only the layout changes.
Desktop band 350-450px: A 409 · B 420 · C 416 (live hero ~649).
Tell us the letter you like; it gets built into the homepage and checked in a real browser at 375 / 768 / 1280.

A · PAPERWORK CARD (recommended)
Copy sits straight on the dark green. The photo becomes a cream document card that also holds the four credentials and the availability pill, so the paperwork and the photo read as one object.
Heights: Mobile 715 · Tablet 444 · Desktop 409.
Why: shortest desktop of the three, and the only one that ties the credentials to the photo (PRODUCT.md principle 1: show the paperwork).
Trade-off: the photo is a wide crop inside a card, smaller on screen than B's arch; 70px longer than C on mobile.

B · ARCH WINDOW
Three columns. The headline is right-aligned into an aviary-arch photo that stands on the hero's bottom edge; the lead, buttons and credentials sit on the far side.
Heights: Mobile 735 · Tablet 438 · Desktop 420.
Why: the biggest photo of the three (360×380 on desktop) and the most distinctive silhouette.
Trade-off: a four-line right-aligned headline on desktop, and the longest mobile of the three.

C · INLINE-PHOTO HEADLINE
Centred and led by the type. The photo is a pill set inside the headline just before 'Midland, Texas', so the sign in the picture echoes the words. Credentials and availability share one line.
Heights: Mobile 645 · Tablet 410 · Desktop 416.
Why: shortest on mobile, and the most typographic.
Trade-off: on tablet and desktop the photo is small (292×96) and has to be decorative to screen readers and image search, because an image inside the H1 would change the heading's text.
